summary: UI test (ProjectUITests.testProjectDiffPillOpensGitDiffPane) opens Pending Changes via project-row context menu and asserts branch/file/Files/Added/Deleted content, then switches to a second project and confirms the summary updates and the first project's file disappears, genuinely rejecting wrong-project-summary violations; the paired unit test only covers correct project routing/selection-preservation, not summary display, but does not misrepresent itself and complements the UI evidence.
